Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear asks and the usage snapshot. High-level recommendation below; attaching a breakdown (modular_plus_pricing_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW for the quantization engagement.

Short answer (one-line): If your traffic spikes are short and you want unit-cost optimization, Modular+ with a small reserved pool + quantization tuning will usually give better cost/latency wins than a straight Elastic tier upgrade. If you need firm throughput guarantees for sustained high concurrency, Dedicated capacity is the safer option.

Options (with quick pros/cons):
- Option A: Straight tier upgrade (Compact -> Elastic)
  - Pros: simpler billing/route, predictable per-token SLA; fast to provision
  - Cons: higher unit cost vs. quantized execution; less control over batching policies

- Option B: Modular+ add-on (Quant+ + adaptive caching) + small reserved pool
  - Pros: Best cost-per-token for long tails, can be paired with burst capacity, includes quantization tuning PS work
  - Cons: Slightly more operational setup; pilot recommended to tune quant profiles and hit P95 targets

- Option C: Dedicated reserved nodes (for peak-critical workloads)
  - Pros: Deterministic throughput and latency, isolation
  - Cons: Higher committed spend; less flexible to downscale quickly

Pilot suggestion (what we propose):
- 6 weeks, focused on a single internal service endpoint (~10% of your traffic)
- Modular+ enabled with two quant profiles (BF16->8-bit and 4-bit aggressive) and prefix/KV cache tuned to your trace distribution
- Success metrics: P95 latency improvement >= 15% OR per-token cost reduction >= 30%
- Deliverables: quantization report, tuned runtime config, SOW-ready tasks for DocuSign

Commercials (preview):
- We can offer a pilot discount (see Ben's note below for specifics) and a one-time onboarding credit to offset PS hours. For procurement concerns: unused committed tokens for pilots are refundable or convertible to hosted credits under a 60-day window (we'll detail in SOW).

Next steps: Ben — can you propose pilot pricing commitment? Priyom — can you confirm an estimated PS hour bucket for quant tuning so we can include it in the SOW?
